description: Follow-up to part06-decisions-1 (docs/probes.md), isolating the two items whose spooled-file capture failed there (CPF3303 'File ... not found') despite their CALL steps logging zero error messages - hypothesis: T612OFA's severity-20 compile failure earlier in that SAME connection's job produced an unmonitored CPF9999 Function Check (RNS9310 unmonitored by the wrapper), which may have left the job's spooled-output state disrupted for the rest of that connection. This connection drops candidate A entirely (already confirmed failing, no need to retry) and re-runs candidate B (T612OFB, oflind(*in01) - confirmed COMPILING at Highest Severity 00 in part06-decisions-1, but its CPYSPLF FILE(P0612A) failed) and a FIXED candidate C (T612OFC source renamed to use QSYSPRT - part06-decisions-1 found the original name choice itself was a bug, CPF4101/RNX1216, unrelated to OFLIND) in a clean job with nothing before them that could disrupt spooling. Also re-runs both 06-14b candidates (Q0614BA dynamic-SQL, Q0614BB persistent-library - both compiled/ran with zero error messages in part06-decisions-1 but also failed CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) the same way) to get a clean read on whether their redesigns actually work.

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CAPT612OFB
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(P0612A) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CAPT612OFC
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CPQ0614BA
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0614BA) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0614BA) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0614BA
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: PERSISTPRIME
steps.cmd:
RUNSQL SQL('DROP TABLE &LIB/W0614BP') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('CREATE TABLE &LIB/W0614BP (TOKCD CHAR(6) NOT NULL, TOKNM VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, TOKLORD DATE, TOKLTS TIMESTAMP NOT NULL)') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/W0614BP VALUES (''C00001'', ''ACME TRADING CO'', DATE ''2026-09-05'', TIMESTAMP ''2026-09-05-08.30.00.000000'')') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/W0614BP VALUES (''C00099'', ''NEW PROSPECT CO'', NULL, TIMESTAMP ''2026-09-20-14.15.00.000000'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CPQ0614BB
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0614BB) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0614BB) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0614BB
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)
